tn: ka malatsi a le {days} a a latelanang ({dates})

tn: Thobo kwa {location} e solofelwa go nna nnye thata go feta ka tlwaelo, e ka nna {gap}% ka fa tlase ga palogare ya kgaolo.

en: The harvest in {location} is expected to be about {gap}% smaller than the district average.
tn: Thobo kwa {location} e solofelwa go nna nnye ka {gap}% go feta palogare ya kgaolo.

tn: Thobo kwa {location} e solofelwa go feta palogare ya kgaolo ka {gap}%.

en: The harvest in {location} is expected to match the district average.
tn: Thobo kwa {location} e solofelwa go lekana le palogare ya kgaolo.

tn: Thobo kwa {location} e solofelwa go nna gaufi le tlwaelo, e ka nna {gap}% ka fa tlase ga palogare ya kgaolo.

tn: {who} e na le mogote o o kwa godimo (go fitlha {max_temp} °C) e bile ga e tshikinyege jaaka letsomane la yone {when}.

en: Body temperature {temps} (fever from {fever} °C); activity {activity} vs. {herd_activity} for the rest of the herd
tn: Mogote wa mmele {temps} (letshoroma go simolola ka {fever} °C); go tshikinyega {activity} go bapisiwa le {herd_activity} ya letsomane lotlhe

en: {who} was much less active than the rest of its herd {when}.
tn: {who} e ne e sa tshikinyege thata go feta letsomane la yone {when}.

en: Activity {activity} vs. {herd_activity} for the rest of the herd; body temperature {temps}
tn: Go tshikinyega {activity} go bapisiwa le {herd_activity} ya letsomane lotlhe; mogote wa mmele {temps}

en: {who} moved much further than the rest of its herd {when}.
tn: {who} e tsamaile kgakala thata go feta letsomane la yone {when}.

en: Moved {distance} in a day vs. {herd_distance} km for the rest of the herd
tn: E tsamaile {distance} ka letsatsi go bapisiwa le {herd_distance} km ya letsomane lotlhe

en: {who} has moved away from its herd {when} and is now about {km} km from it. It may be lost or stolen.
tn: {who} e tlogile mo letsomaneng la yone {when} mme jaanong e kgakala ka {km} km. E ka tswa e latlhegile kgotsa e utswitswe.

en: Moved {distance} per day vs. {herd_distance} km for the rest of the herd; {km_exact} km from the herd's median position on {date}
tn: E tsamaile {distance} ka letsatsi go bapisiwa le {herd_distance} km ya letsomane lotlhe; {km_exact} km go tswa fa letsomane le leng teng ka {date}
{who} ga e a nna le ditemoso go tloga ka {start} go fitlha ka {end}.

en: Body temperature {temps}; activity {activity} on average vs. {herd_activity} for the rest of the herd; moved {distance} km a day on average
tn: Mogote wa mmele {temps}; go tshikinyega {activity} ka palogare go bapisiwa le {herd_activity} ya letsomane lotlhe; e tsamaile {distance} km ka letsatsi ka palogare

en: Possible disease outbreak: {count} animals in {herds} ({animals}) have shown signs of illness since {date}.
tn: Go ka tswa go na le go anama ga bolwetse: diphologolo di le {count} mo {herds} ({animals}) di bontshitse matshwao a bolwetse go tloga ka {date}.

en: Rule: {min} or more possibly ill animals in one district within {window} days, based on the possible-illness flags in livestock_alerts.csv. Highest body temperatures: {peaks}
tn: Molao: diphologolo di le {min} kgotsa go feta tse di ka tswang di lwala mo kgaolong e le nngwe mo malatsing a le {window}, go ya ka ditshupo tsa bolwetse mo livestock_alerts.csv. Mogote o o kwa godimo go gaisa: {peaks}

tn: Dipalo tsa dijalo le leruo ke tsa sekai, ga se tsa masimo a mmatota

tn: Setswana: phetolelo ya ntlha, e santse e tlhatlhobiwa

tn: Ditemoso tsa pele tsa dijalo le leruo · kgaolo ya {district}

Ditemoso tsa go anama ga bolwetse

tn: Dikgakololo di le {n} di santse di tlhoka phetolelo ya Setswana; di bontshiwa ka Sekgoa go fitlha ka nako eo.
Temoso e le 1, e e potlakang go gaisa pele.
Ditemoso di le {n}, tse di potlakang go gaisa pele.

tn: Seemo ga se a kgona go bolokwa: {error}

en: Dots show where each animal was on the chosen day, coloured by its risk level.
tn: Dikhutlo di bontsha kwa phologolo nngwe le nngwe e neng e le teng ka letsatsi le le tlhophilweng, ka mmala wa kotsi ya yone.
Tsela ya phologolo e e timetseng

en: Map tiles need internet. Without it, the animals still show on a blank background.
tn: Mmapa o tlhoka inthanete. Fa e seyo, diphologolo di santse di bonala mo bokamorago jo bo se nang sepe.

en: Choose an animal on the map or in the list.
tn: Tlhopha phologolo mo mmapeng kgotsa mo lenaneong.

en: No animals shown. Select at least one risk level above the map.
tn: Ga go na diphologolo tse di bontshiwang. Tlhopha bonnye kotsi e le nngwe fa godimo ga mmapa.

en: Activity compared with the rest of the herd
tn: Go tshikinyega go bapisiwa le letsomane lotlhe
Ga go na ditemoso tsa phologolo eno.

en: Tonnes per hectare, seasons 2001–2024. The dashed line is the district average used by the crop model.
tn: Ditone ka hekethara, ditlha 2001–2024. Mola o o kgaoganeng ke palogare ya kgaolo e e dirisiwang ke sekao sa dijalo.

en: Line chart of yield per site and season
tn: Kerafo ya thobo ka lefelo le setlha

en: Rule from the team plan: below 70% of average is High, 70–90% Medium, above 90% Low.
tn: Molao go tswa mo leanong la setlhopha: ka fa tlase ga 70% ya palogare ke Kwa godimo, 70–90% ke Magareng, go feta 90% ke Kwa tlase.
Ka nako eo go tswa mo sekaong sa didirisiwa

en: Collars measure skin temperature with an infrared sensor (GY-906), which reads lower than body temperature. The {threshold} °C line is a demo threshold, not a veterinary fever limit. A collar the gateway has not heard for a minute is shown as "not seen", the way a missing animal at the kraal would be.
tn: Dikolara di lekanya mogote wa letlalo ka sensara ya infrared (GY-906), e e balang kwa tlase go feta mogote wa mmele. Mola wa {threshold} °C ke moedi wa pontsho, ga se moedi wa letshoroma wa bongaka. Kolara e gateway e sa e utlwang mo motsotsong o le mongwe e bontshiwa e le "ga e bonwe", fela jaaka phologolo e e seyong mo sakeng.

tn: Dashboard ga e a kgona go bula data ya disensara: {error}

tn: Ga go ise go nne le data. Golaganya UNO mme o simolole: python firmware/serial_bridge.py
